test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 8 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Fill in the blank with the most appropriate word.**

They ______ like bitter enemies but soon make up.
solution:
The correct answer is '**quarrel**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate word for the given blank is '**quarrel**'.
 
• It means** 'an angry argument or disagreement'.** [झगड़ा या विवाद (बातचीत में)]
 
 
• *Example: We sometimes have a **quarrel** about who should do the washing-up.*
 
 
 
• A '**quarrel**' is an angry argumen
